hero.title:
From Git to production —
on your own server.
hero.subtitle: GAMAD Deploy automates application deployment on the VPS of your choice. Your infrastructure, your data, your independence.
features.title: Everything you need to deploy with confidence
features.subtitle: A complete platform built for teams that refuse to depend on foreign cloud providers.
features.git.title: Git-based deployment
features.git.desc: Push to `main`, your app deploys. No manual server configuration. Every commit becomes a traceable deployment.
features.wizard.title: Smart wizard
features.wizard.desc: GAMAD detects your stack (Node, React, Docker) and generates your configuration automatically. No YAML to write.
features.agent.title: Sovereign VPS agent
features.agent.desc: Your agent runs on YOUR server (Hetzner, OVH, AWS…). You keep the contract, the keys and the data.
features.sovereign.title: Zero data leakage
features.sovereign.desc: Your code and secrets never transit through our servers. GDPR compliance and local regulations guaranteed.
features.multitenant.title: Multi-project & team
features.multitenant.desc: Manage multiple projects, invite your team, isolate access by role. Built to grow with you.
features.payment.title: GeniusPay payments
features.payment.desc: Subscribe in XOF via GeniusPay. No international Visa card, no banking friction. Pay local.
how.title: Deploy in three steps
how.subtitle: From your Git repo to your production app, with no surprises.
how.step1.title: Connect your repository
how.step1.desc: Link your GitHub account and select the project to deploy. GAMAD analyzes your code automatically.
how.step2.title: Configure your VPS
how.step2.desc: Enter your server credentials. Our agent installs and configures nginx, SSL and environment variables.
how.step3.title: Deploy and sleep
how.step3.desc: Every push triggers automatic deployment with health checks, instant rollback and real-time logs.
